Four raid HUD fixes shipped this run (v32.11 to v32.14), but the raid screens are not at 4 yet. Critic on screen 50 after v32.13 was 3, up from 2. I did not re-judge screen 21. Screens 19, 20, 22–24, 33, 34, 36, 37, 48, 51, 61 and 78 have never been critiqued.

Each fix passed preflight and the full gate, including the seed 4242 fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

- **v32.11 stamina word:** the word now sits inside its bar, like armour and hp. The bar fills are one step darker so the cream text reads.
- **v32.12 extract distance:** the "extract 131m" line now sits on the same plate as the score block.
- **v32.13 gun name:** the gun name is now the label size in grey, so the ammo figure is the one hero.
- **v32.14 f1 controls hint:** the hint now sits on a plate in the quiet grey text colour.

Still open from the critic:
- **Run info heading:** it has two headings, "run info" and "run goals". Old check 27.42 needs the "run goals" heading, so I left both.
- **Bottom row:** the hotbar's selected and wielded slots use two different highlights, and the lime "fire" chip is the only lime on screen.
- **Smaller P2 items:** stamina text contrast, the ammo card sitting 10px from the edge, uneven toast chip widths, and dim idle hotbar slots.

I skipped two critic suggestions. I did not raise the 8px gap between the minimap and run info because it is the column's rhythm (his top-right column order). I did not add a calm-state key-legend fix because the legend already folds to the one-line hint after 30 seconds.

Notes are in `notes/02-raid-hud-redesign.md`, the visible changes are logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`, and the pictures are in `notes/shots/c-02-r16-before` and `c-02-r16-after`.

NEXT: re-shoot 21 and 50 after v32.14 and run the critic on both. Then plain the lime "fire" chip, even out the toast chips, and lift the idle hotbar slots.
